profile_text.body:
RichTech Robotics Inc. is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website given for the company is rolls-royce.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than a robotics business. In that text, Rolls-Royce says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, and describes itself as pioneering technologies for clean, safe and competitive power solutions, with more than 100 years at the forefront of innovation.

The same site text lists several announcements: Rolls-Royce completing a $1 billion investment in Indiana, a stated intent by Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, cooperation between Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and Rolls-Royce SMR holding multiple contractual commitments to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The record carries the aliases RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. and RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC-CL B. No lawsuits are listed, and Nevada is recorded as the law exposure jurisdiction with a count of zero. No AI products and no MCP servers are associated with the company.
